questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was important for me that the level of academic load was lower than I was used to at Copenhagen University

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I would say that it's pretty difficult. If you know somebody in the host country, you should try to make it out. Otherwise it will be very expensive. We had trouble with Airbnb, besides it is cheaper if you can cut the Tier-1 supplier off, it would be nice

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Very expensive

questions.answer: Very different from course to course

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Easier, especially in the everyday life. The exams are difficult in the sense of remembering things in a different way than home

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: GLOBAL CHALLENGES TO DEMOCRACY, INTERNATIONAL POLITICAL ECONOMY AND THE WELFARE STATE, GLOBALISATION AND REGIONALISATION IN INTERNATIONAL SECURITY, INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS OF EAST ASIA

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: GLOBALISATION AND REGIONALISATION IN INTERNATIONAL SECURITY. Good structured course with a good professor and the level is also high
